# Jim Wilson's Mathematics Education Resource Center

> Comprehensive collection of mathematics education courses, research projects, and problem-solving resources from a University of Georgia mathematics educator.

Jim Wilson's site hosts graduate-level mathematics education courses (EMAT series), research initiatives like the NSF-funded Situations Project, and extensive materials on geometry, problem-solving, and technology integration in mathematics instruction. The site serves as a repository for both instructional resources and scholarly work in mathematics education.

## Key Topics

- Mathematics Education
- Problem-Solving
- Geometry
- Geometer's Sketchpad (GSP)
- Technology Integration
- Secondary Mathematics
- Graduate Courses
- NCTM
- Heron's Formula
- Arithmetic Mean-Geometric Mean Inequality
- NSF-funded Research
- Situations Project
- Mathematical Proofs
- Teacher Education
- University of Georgia

## Graduate Courses & Instruction

- [EMAT 6680 Course Page](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/EMT668/EMT668.html): EMAT 6680 course materials on technology-integrated mathematics education
- [EMAT 4600/6600 Page](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/EMT725/EMT725.html): EMAT 4600/6600 course page with problem-solving and geometry materials
- [EMAT 7050 Mathematics Instruction](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/EMAT7050/EMAT7050.Fa14.html): EMAT 7050 graduate course on mathematics instruction and teacher education
- [EMAT 6500 Connections in Secondary Mathematics](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/EMAT6500/EMAT6500.html): EMAT 6500 graduate course on secondary math connections and pedagogy
- [EMAT 6450 Mathematics in Context](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/EMAT6450/EMAT6450.fa2014.html): EMAT 6450 course on contextual and applied mathematics learning
- [EMAT 6690 Using Computers in Mathematics Instruction](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/EMT669.html): EMAT 6690 course on computer integration in mathematics instruction
- [EMAT 6700](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/EMT670/EMAT6700.html): EMAT 6700 graduate course in mathematics education
- [MATH 7200 Geometry Course](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/MATH7200/MATH7200.html): MATH 7200 geometry course covering Euclidean and non-Euclidean systems
- [EMAT 8990 Doctoral Seminar](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/EMAT8990/EMAT8990.html): EMAT 8990 doctoral seminar on geometry research and visualization
- [EMT 600 Special Problem in Mathematics Education](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/EMT600/emt600.html): EMT 600 directed study course in mathematics education

## Research Projects & Initiatives

- [Situations Project](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/Situations/Situations.html): NSF-funded Situations Project for secondary mathematics teacher knowledge
- [2008 NCTM Illuminations Institute](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/Illuminations/Illum2008.html): NCTM Illuminations Institute materials on problem-solving and geometry
- [RCML2009 Keynote](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/TiMER/RCML200l.html): RCML keynote on geometry education, problem-solving, and technology

## Problem-Solving & Mathematical Topics

- [Problem Solving with Heron's Formula](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/NCTM Boston Project/Heron/Outline.html): Educational guide on problem solving using Heron's Formula
- [Using the Arithmetic Mean-Geometric Mean Inequality in Problem Solving](https://jwilson.coe.uga.edu/EMT725/AMGM/SSMA.Bnghm.html): Problem-solving guide using AM-GM inequality theorem
